sources.tracks: 28 calendar days (onshore refusal), 7 working days (s 116 onshore cancellation), 7 working days (immigration detention), 70 days (offshore sponsor review)

sources.name_en: Ministerial Direction No. 110 — Visa Refusal and Cancellation under s 501 & Revocation
sources.tracks: Primary considerations: Protection of Australian community (safety as highest priority), Family violence, Strength/nature/duration of ties, Best interests of minor children, Expectations of community

sources.tracks: Condition breach (8107/8607/8202), change of circumstances, risk to health/safety/good order; strict NOICC response timeframes (typically 5 working days)

sources.tracks: PIC 4020(1)/(2) 3-yr bar (Waiver available under 4020(4) for compassionate/compelling interests of AU citizen/PR) vs PIC 4020(2A)/(2B) 10-yr identity bar (NO waiver)

sources.name_ko: Migration Regulations Schedule 4 — PIC 4013 / PIC 4014 (비자 취소·불법체류 출국 후 3년 입국금지)
sources.name_en: Migration Regulations Schedule 4 — PIC 4013 / PIC 4014 (3-Year Exclusion Period After Cancellation or Unlawful Departure)
sources.tracks: 3-year exclusion from temporary visas if departing unlawful (>28 days after expiry) or on BVC/BVD/BVE; affects temporary visas (not permanent PR visas unless specified)

sources.tracks: Compelling and compassionate circumstances developed since visa grant, beyond applicant's control, resulting in major change (note: marriage/pregnancy alone usually insufficient unless complicated)
